nom: bareMinerals SKINLONGEVITY Cushion Cloud Gentle Foaming Cleanser

segments.oily: One reviewer with an oily face reports the cleanser controlled oil without drying her skin out, unlike other cleansers she had tried.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some with eczema, report it leaves skin soft, smooth, and hydrated rather than stripped, even after just a week of use.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it absorbs quickly and keeps their skin balanced without excess dryness or oil.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some prone to redness, rosacea, or eczema, overwhelmingly report no irritation and describe the cleanser as gentle enough for daily use.

concerns.redness: Reviewers with reactive or rosacea-prone skin report their face looks less red and brighter after use, with no flare-ups triggered by the cleanser.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several with sensitive or acne-prone skin, report no breakouts, though one reviewer with acne-prone skin felt the formula needed a stronger acne-fighting ingredient and broke out within days.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers report the mineral-herb formula seemed to strengthen and calm their skin barrier over two weeks of use, resulting in clearer, brighter skin.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the cleanser does not leave skin feeling tight or stripped, though a couple of early reviewers say it felt drying compared to what the cream-like texture promised.

aspects.libelle: Lathers less than expected for a foaming cleanser
Reformulation disappoints fans of the discontinued predecessor
Leaves a squeaky-clean, sometimes tight feeling
A little goes a long way

extraits.texte: why do companies always do this?? a popular, loved product rebranded reformulated and turned to garbage. taking my money elsewhere. so sad

extraits.titre: Great Product for the right skin type
extraits.texte: I received bareMinerals Skin Longevity Cushion Cloud Foaming Cleanser as a sample product to review and it has a lot of great features and could be a good and gentle cleanser for people without acne prone skin I believe. I personally need something with either benzoyl peroxide or glycolic acid to keep my acne at bay so I noticed that my face started to break out a few days after using it because I think my skin needs an acne fighting ingredient to be in my cleanser. This cleanser has a great texture and did foam up really nicely. It has a very clean feel and the packaging is really beautiful and simple as well. It doesn't have any scent, I personally prefer some scent to my facial products but I know a lot of people don't so that is a pro as well.

I was excited to review this product for free from Buzzagent. I have been using this product morning and night for 10 days. I have dry sensitive skin that is often red. The consistency was more cream than foaming. It foamed just a little bit. It was gentle on my skin. From day 1, my face appeared less red and more bright. The brightness didn't last long though. I do think it hydrated and cleaned well. It didn't have that tight feeling afterwards that some cleaners do. I did have a few more breakouts during these 10 days, but it could be hormonal. Overall, I liked the product and would buy again.

The name says it all…this gentle foaming cleanser literally feels as soft and light as a cloud, while at the same time, has the strength and power to remove makeup and sunscreen. A tiny bit of this cleanser goes a long way, as the cleanser lathers nicely. I have very sensitive and breakout prone slime, and this product did not irritate my skin at all. In fact, my skin was left clean and moisturized with this product. I highly recommend this product and will be trying other products in the SKINLONGEVITY line as I was so pleased with the cleanser!

For somewhere has eczema and extremely dry and sensitive skin, this face wash is so soft and gentle on my skin without sacrificing the perfect wash. My face feels cool and refreshed all day long. It remi ds me of a lighter version of Noxema without the smell. I like it!

I was really impressed by this cleanser. I have pretty sensitive, dry skin and this did a great job of making my skin feel clean but not stripped. It sort of reminded me of Tula's cleanser but my skin felt much more hydrated. Love and will purchase again.
